guardrails: Generated claims must be bound to an exact current dispatch ticket.

A dispatch ticket binds worker, slot, assignment, work item, allocator generation, portfolio policy, routing generation, worker-profile generation, routing-learning generation, assignment score and routing score.
Manual reroutes remain allowed but require an explicit override reason and do not count as generated routing evidence.
Dispatch tickets never authorize outreach, purchases, private-data access or other external actions.
Pre-V14 claims are grandfathered only by explicit claim ID.
V15 tickets validate against append-only dispatch history so completed historical claims survive later rerouting.
A generated claim against a V15 ticket is rejected before eligibility or after hard expiry.
Work-steal tickets require dispatch_kind=work_steal and their exact parent ticket.
V16 generated claims additionally require a fresh activation bound to worker presence.
V19 dispatch identity includes V18 exploration generation, pair, baseline slot and route mode.
Work-steal tickets preserve the original primary route's V18 exploration identity for audit but remain ineligible for matched worker-effect analysis.
